anomalies.description: Individual in hooded sweatshirt exhibits suspicious behavior: approaches stairs cautiously, repeatedly looks around, adjusts hood/clothing as if concealing identity or preparing for illicit action; no visible weapon but posture and furtive movements suggest potential burglary or reconnaissance. No direct violence observed, but high-risk pre-criminal behavior consistent with surveillance anomalies.

original_descriptions.description: Individual in hooded sweatshirt exhibits suspicious behavior: approaches stairs cautiously, repeatedly looks around, adjusts hood/clothing as if concealing identity or preparing for illicit action; no visible weapon but posture and furtive movements suggest potential burglary or reconnaissance. Individual in hooded jacket exhibits suspicious behavior: approaches stairs, pauses, looks around furtively, then crouches and appears to conceal or manipulate something near waist/hip area—consistent with preparing or concealing a weapon (e.g., firearm) or engaging in illicit activity such as burglary preparation. No visible weapon, but posture, hesitation, and concealment actions are highly atypical for normal pedestrian movement and align with pre-incident indicators of crime (e.g., armed robbery or trespass with intent).

anomalies.description: At frame 7 (29.0s), the individual suddenly extends their right arm forward and a bright flash/spark erupts from the hand area, consistent with muzzle flash from a firearm discharge. Immediately after, in frames 8–10, the person rapidly turns and flees down the stairs, exhibiting evasive behavior typical after firing a weapon. No other person is visible, but the sudden flash and abrupt flight strongly indicate a shooting event, matching the expected anomaly pattern of people reacting to gunfire (here, the shooter themselves fleeing post-discharge).
